name: WGPT sell hook burns treasury LP before crediting the deposit
summary: AiWGPTToken.transferFrom executes its treasury-funded LP removal and exact-output WGPT purchase before crediting the caller’s deposit to the pair. The hook updates pool reserves, then credits an unconsumed deposit that the caller can reclaim with skim. Repeated calls consume treasury LP and raise the WGPT price, allowing the caller to sell the retained tokens for USDT.

loss.notes: Net USDT depletion of the token contract and its WGPT/USDT pool, measured from all receipt Transfer events. Pool net change is -105212.230996130493027690 USDT and token-contract change is +22636.034519356989903313 USDT. This offsets all campaign inflows, including the attacker’s 30000 USDT treasury funding and initial swap inputs. Gross removal of treasury LP cannot be valued separately from the same transaction’s trades. Financing fees, gas and later recoveries are not deducted. Attacker reinvestment in its EXPToken/USDT pool is not another loss component.

ageReset.description: The deployed sell hook updates pool reserves before crediting a reclaimable deposit. Pool registration, trading permission, treasury funding and LP-offset edits change exposure or loss size.

sources.note:
Reviewed anchor, root cause, loss, direct artifact and complete age history. Etherscan V2 getsourcecode returns verified AiWGPTToken, compiler v0.6.12. Source-1 callTracer reaches transferFrom(0x23b872dd) on 0x1f415255f7e2a8546559a553e962de7bc60d7942 from attacker helper 0x5336a15f27b74f62cc182388c005df419ffb58b8. There are 32 sell-hook/skim cycles, not the 540 iterations in the discovery test. sellburnToken uses 20% of the supplied amount, removes token-owned LP from 0x5a596eae0010e16ed3b021fc09bbf0b7f1b2d3cd using its current WGPT balance divided by LP supply, buys the remaining WGPT for address(0), and burns the withdrawn WGPT. Both operations synchronize reserves before transferFrom credits the supplied WGPT to the pool. skim(0xbc25cf77) then returns 95% of that credit to the helper and sends the 5% buy fee to rateAddr. The helper repeats without surrendering the full deposit, then sells its retained WGPT. The ordinary PancakeSwap pair and attacker machinery contain no implicated defect.

Source-3 is direct CREATE at 29231744:104 by 0xc1727c083ea796addefcf594ce9114160a49f3aa. Runtime is empty at 29231743 and the 12507-byte runtime hashes identically at deployment, 29891709 and source-1 prestateTracer. Verified code contains no upgrade, delegatecall or destruction path. Its custom Ownable has no ownership events, so inspect owner account txlist rather than relying on logs. Etherscan txlist from deployment through the anchor returns 86 owner-account transactions and all successful token control calls are covered by source-4. Only this pool is registered, at 29231801:89, and swapLPAddr is assigned once, at 29231976:136. That pointer routes the existing defective hook to the token’s ordinary PancakeSwap pool. Registration, token/LP allowances and funding enable execution of the same algorithm, rather than introducing defective code or an unsafe pricing parameter. Slots 0x07/0x08 retain constructor buyRate=500 and burnRate=2000. The owner never changes either rate or transfers ownership before the exploit. Whitelist changes, setBurnToken(false/true) at 29863431/29863711, and setIsSwap(true) at 29891552:67 change who can enter the existing hook. They are exposure gates. Router and USDT addresses are constructor constants with no setters.

LP offset slot 0x0b was changed repeatedly, last at 29891507:67 to 50000000000000111. To reproduce the causal check, obtain source-1 callTracer, then debug_traceCall its root from/to/input with gas=0x1c9c380 at parent block 29891709 using callTracer and stateOverrides[token].stateDiff[32-byte slot 0x0b]. Override only that slot to the exploit value, constructor value 1000000000000000, earlier value 100000000000000000, or zero. Every replay succeeds with 32 burns and 32 skims. Sum successful USDT transfer/transferFrom calls across the token-plus-pool boundary, excluding reverted call subtrees. Their respective net depletions are 82576196476773503124377, 82584878276010023110012, 82567339578415337659990 and 82585055476607797163846 wei. The offset edits change size, not the existence of the exercised condition. Deployment is therefore the latest age-bearing change, 1986040 seconds before the exploit.

Episode coverage is deployment through BSC block 125541856. Query pool Burn(address,uint256,uint256,address) logs in 1000000-block intervals and trace all unique transactions. The 511 Burns occur in 480 transactions, 155 before the anchor. Only source-1 has any successful skim calls. Earlier burn transactions have two pool swaps each, the hook purchase and the ordinary caller sale, and no reclaimed deposit. To exclude split-transaction skims, query WGPT Transfer logs with indexed from=0x5a596eae0010e16ed3b021fc09bbf0b7f1b2d3cd, plus pool Swap/Burn logs over the same interval, splitting requests if the response limit is exceeded. There are 32712 outgoing Transfer logs and 32330 Swap/Burn logs. For each transaction sum outgoing WGPT quantities, including the fee leg, and compare with Swap amount0Out plus Burn amount0. Only source-1 has excess outgoing WGPT, exactly 310454388748421891976392 wei. This excludes an earlier or later nonzero skim and closes split-transaction scope for this registered pool. Complete owner txlist through coverage has 209 transactions. Source-5 at 29891867:78 disables burnToken, which stays disabled. Source-6 at 30469305:52 renounces ownership to zero. No further pool registration or pointer reassignment occurs. Owner-deployed token 0x2e7c87088ef4ecbfa2b91023be6a94dde090eff0 has a different 6168-byte runtime hash 0x160c83a915d357857bea83572d80382d1bfcdce9beb5f3e7e3d4e8834b60f3a0 and is not this artifact.

Loss is reproduced from source-1 USDT Transfer logs, using 18 decimals and USD parity. Summing all movements across the token-plus-pool boundary gives -82576196476773503124377 wei after identifiable campaign inputs. This measures direct stable-asset depletion, not WGPT marked at its manipulated price. Proceeds are reinvested in attacker-created EXPToken/USDT pool 0xaa07222e4c3295c4e881ac8640fbe5fb921d6840 and LP is minted to the attacker, so a zero final helper USDT balance does not erase the loss. Future updates should extend the same outgoing-Transfer/Swap/Burn reconciliation beyond 125541856 and merge any confirmed recurrence.
